quotes.verbatim_quote:
This is a very common sequence in Brazilian music and Blues music, where all the chords of the turnaround
     become dominant with different voicings. Each dominant chord is leading to the next chord untill it finally
     leads to the tonic key (I).
quotes.why_load_bearing: This is the only full-sentence prose rule in the chapter, explicitly naming the structural principle that unifies the all-dominant turnaround pattern used in both Blues and Brazilian music.
